parties: <cite index="6-1">Apar Industries Limited raised ₹2,500 crore from a Qualified Institutional Placement of 16,88,618 equity shares</cite>. <cite index="6-7">ICICI Securities Limited and Motilal Oswal Investment Advisors Limited acted as lead managers</cite>.
headline: APAR Industries completes ₹2,500 cr QIP at ₹14,805/share, placing 16.88 lakh shares to institutional buyers.
sum: <cite index="16-4,16-6">Apar Industries Limited successfully raised approximately ₹2,500 crore through a qualified institutions placement of equity shares, with the issue opening on 10 August and closing on 13 August 2026.</cite> <cite index="1-6">The company issued 16,88,618 equity shares at an issue price of ₹14,805 per share, at a premium of ₹14,795 per share.</cite>
implication: QIP mechanics emphasise speed and institutional-only placement under SEBI ICDR Reg 172–180; the 9.99% discount and 45-day lock-in reflect market practice for capital-efficient fundraising bypassing public offer complexity.
detail: <cite index="1-1,1-2">The Share Issue Committee of Directors approved the allotment at its meeting held on 13 August 2026, following the issue opening on 10 August and closing on 13 August 2026.</cite> <cite index="30-6">The company's paid-up equity share capital increased from ₹40,18,37,190, comprising 4,01,83,719 shares with a face value of ₹10 each, to ₹41,87,23,370 with a total of 4,18,72,337 shares.</cite> <cite index="25-2">Notable allottees included ICICI Prudential Flexicap Fund, HDFC Flexi Cap Fund, SBI Contra Fund, and international entities like Nomura India Investment Fund Mother Fund and Abu Dhabi Investment Authority.</cite> <cite index="31-11">The proceeds of the QIP are proposed to be utilised towards funding working capital requirements and general corporate purposes.</cite>

framework.note: Central: QIP eligibility, floor pricing formula (Reg. 176), allotment & lock-in rules; company must be listed ≥1 year, comply with minimum public shareholding.
Central: Equity issuance authority; special resolution required from shareholders (obtained 30 July 2026 per ZeroDha/Screener).
Central: QIP must be completed within 365 days of shareholder approval; timeline compliance trigger.
Central: Trading window closure (7 Aug–16 Aug 2026) per compliance code of conduct.

framework.note: Central: Material event disclosure to NSE/BSE of issue opening, allotment, lock-in details.
Technical: Floor price calculation-average weekly high/low of prior 2 weeks; ₹14,801.25 floor applied.
Procedural: Exchange filing of preliminary placement document (PPD), allotment outcome, shareholding pattern post-allotment.

timeline.t: Board of Directors approves fundraising proposal for up to ₹2,500 crore
Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) approves special resolution for QIP authority
Trading window closure for designated persons and insiders (trading window remains closed until 48 hrs post-results announcement)
Share Issue Committee approves QIP opening; floor price set at ₹14,801.25/share; relevant date fixed; preliminary placement document filed with BSE & NSE; QIP opens post market-hours
QIP issue closes at 2:00 PM (after 3-day collection period); Share Issue Committee meets to approve allotment of 16,88,618 shares at final issue price ₹14,805/share
Trading window reopens for designated persons; listed shares commence trading on BSE/NSE
Bar & Bench article published announcing the deal and law firm roles
